message.content:
**Allele frequency of rs7412 (APOE ε2) in Europeans**

| Population | Allele frequency (C allele) |
|------------|------------------------------|
| All European (EUR) – 1000 Genomes Phase 3 | **≈ 0.12–0.13** |
| Northern Europeans (CEU) | ≈ 0.13 |
| Southern Europeans (TSI) | ≈ 0.11 |
| Ashkenazi Jews (IBS) | ≈ 0.10 |

> **Interpretation**  
> The rs7412 SNP encodes the ε2 allele of the APOE gene (Cys112Arg). In the combined European cohort from the 1000 Genomes Project, the minor allele (C) occurs in roughly 12–13 % of chromosomes. Frequencies vary modestly among sub‑populations but remain within the 10–13 % range.

> **Sources**  
> * 1000 Genomes Project Phase 3 – European (EUR) dataset.  
> * ExAC/gnomAD v2.1.1 – European (non-Finnish) allele counts.  

If you need more granular data (e.g., by country or by specific ancestry groups), let me know and I can pull the exact counts from gnomAD or the 1000 Genomes browser.
